evidence.A: Cartesian checker verdicts over 385 pair-by-operator cells; LEGAL=30 ILLEGAL=355; per-operator counts in legality_counts.per_operator.
evidence.B: Mechanically independent fusion.attempt (does not import checker, does not read the three graph JSON files) was run on LEGAL samples in both orientations (must succeed) and on ILLEGAL samples (must refuse or yield an invalid IR). A checker whose refusals were never attempted would fail this.

honesty.not_claimed: This unit does not claim consumption of the 108-blueprint production merge map or fetched licence files. The checker is proven on a reconstructed fixture corpus that encodes the named compat, conflict, and licence rules those upstream units would supply. Missing live upstream files are recorded present=false.

question_or_target: Implementation target: a checker that, given a source pair and an operator, returns LEGAL or ILLEGAL with a reason - consuming the symmetrised compat relation, the mechanism conflict edges and the licence compatibility matrix - so an illegal fusion is refused before it is attempted.
